info.name: Crazy Love
info.plot:
Parla di un uomo che finge di avere un'amnesia quando gli viene detto che sarà ucciso e una donna che finge di essere la sua fidanzata quando le viene detto che non ha molto tempo da vivere.

No Go-Jin (Kim Jae-Wook) è l'insegnante di matematica più popolare nel campo dell'istruzione privata ed è il CEO di GOTOP Education. Anche se ha solo un'istruzione di livello liceale, ha raggiunto tutto il suo successo grazie alla sua estrema intelligenza. Appare come un uomo perfetto con un bell'aspetto, un alto QI e ricchezza. È anche narcisista. Un giorno, viene improvvisamente avvertito che sarà assassinato.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.plot: A genius Noh Gojin ignores death threats. His secretary Lee Sina gets deadly ill and dreams revenge.

translations.value: A genius Noh Gojin ignores death threats. His secretary Lee Sina gets deadly ill and dreams revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.plot: Sina takes revenge on Gojin, but gets flabbergasted when he loses his memories from a car accident.

translations.value: Sina takes revenge on Gojin, but gets flabbergasted when he loses his memories from a car accident.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.plot: Sina pretends to be Gojin's fiancée to take revenge and finds tormenting him rather enjoyable.

translations.value: Sina pretends to be Gojin's fiancée to take revenge and finds tormenting him rather enjoyable.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.plot: Sina deceives Gojin's friend Segi and enters his house. Kang Min, who ran over Gojin, visits him.

translations.value: Sina deceives Gojin's friend Segi and enters his house. Kang Min, who ran over Gojin, visits him.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.plot: Gojin deceives everyone by faking his amnesia. On the night of the accident, Gojin saw the culprit.

translations.value: Gojin deceives everyone by faking his amnesia. On the night of the accident, Gojin saw the culprit.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.plot: Noh Gojin hires the best private detective "John" to investigate. Sina keeps taking revenge on him.

translations.value: Noh Gojin hires the best private detective "John" to investigate. Sina keeps taking revenge on him.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.plot: After witnessing a young man's car accident, Sina accepts her deadly fate and stops taking revenge.

translations.value: After witnessing a young man's car accident, Sina accepts her deadly fate and stops taking revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.plot: It turns out Sina's cancer was misdiagnosed. It is also revealed that Gojin does not have amnesia.

translations.value: It turns out Sina's cancer was misdiagnosed. It is also revealed that Gojin does not have amnesia.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.plot: After they kissed, Go Jin and Si Na's hearts flutter. Go Jin speaks rudely to Si Na because of Soo Yeong.

translations.value: After they kissed, Go Jin and Si Na's hearts flutter. Go Jin speaks rudely to Si Na because of Soo Yeong.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.plot: The person who Gojin saw on the night of the accident was Oh Segi. Gojin's feelings for Sina grow.

translations.value: The person who Gojin saw on the night of the accident was Oh Segi. Gojin's feelings for Sina grow.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.plot: After seeing Sina's will, Gojin realizes he loves her. Segi conspires to drive Gojin out of Gotop.

translations.value: After seeing Sina's will, Gojin realizes he loves her. Segi conspires to drive Gojin out of Gotop.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.plot: Gojin and Sina's romance begins. Gojin firmly believes Sina to be terminally ill driving her crazy!

translations.value: Gojin and Sina's romance begins. Gojin firmly believes Sina to be terminally ill driving her crazy!

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.plot: Sooyeong challenges Sina to confess that Gojin was her first love. Gojin faces a crisis due to Segi's scheme.

translations.value: Sooyeong challenges Sina to confess that Gojin was her first love. Gojin faces a crisis due to Segi's scheme.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.plot: Gojin overcomes the crisis, however the doubts on Segi's actions still remains. A surveillance camera shows another man when the accident happened.

translations.value: Gojin overcomes the crisis, however the doubts on Segi's actions still remains. A surveillance camera shows another man when the accident happened.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.plot: Gojin sincerely apologizes to the people around him and vows to protect them. Sina roots for Gojin.

translations.value: Gojin sincerely apologizes to the people around him and vows to protect them. Sina roots for Gojin.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.plot: Gojin catches the culprit, and Gojin and Segi reconcile. A year later, Sina and Gojin are newlyweds.

translations.value: Gojin catches the culprit, and Gojin and Segi reconcile. A year later, Sina and Gojin are newlyweds.
